name: Big Sweep
description: A long, deep fall of pitch from high above.

name: Deep Kick
description: Lower and longer.

description: Its pitch settled higher.

name: Long Kick
description: The kick let ring.

description: More click and a shorter boom.

description: The kick cut short.

description: The kick with its attack at nothing.

description: The closed hat at its shortest.

name: Machine Crash
description: The later machine's crash as it has it.

description: A little lower, with a long room.

description: Its noise's band moved down.

description: The clap with the least of its room.

description: The clap with the most of its room.

description: A dry, bright snap.

name: Thin Clap
description: High and dry.

description: The high tom cut short.

name: Machine Ride
description: The later machine's ride as it has it.

name: Low Rim
description: Tuned down.

description: Its resonators let ring.

name: Short Rim
description: Shorter still.

name: Tick Rim
description: As high and short as it goes.
